evidence.detail: Uses data="{{list}}" — 'data' alone is not a valid HTML5 attribute; valid form is data-* (e.g. data-list)
Reads the attribute with .attr("data") — works via jQuery's arbitrary-attr support but relies on the invalid attribute name

triage.fix_sketch: In decksite/templates/recentdecks.mustache line 7: change data="{{list}}" to data-list="{{list}}". In shared_web/static/js/pd.js line 439: change .attr("data") to .attr("data-list") (or .data("list") which reads the same HTML5 data attribute). Two-file change, ~2 lines total.
triage.notes: The existing code works in practice because jQuery .attr() reads arbitrary attributes, but it is invalid HTML and will cause validation failures. The rename is fully backward-compatible at runtime.
